title: MCC Island Enhanced
description: A simple modpack to enhance your experience on MCC Island
body:
# MCC Island Enhanced

A curated Fabric 1.21.11 modpack built specifically for enhancing the experience on [MCC Island](https://mccisland.net). It bundles the essential client-side mods and panorama resource packs to give you the smoothest, best-looking experience on the server.

## What's included

### Essential MCC Island Mods
- Noxesium - official MCC Island companion mod with server-side feature support
- Trident - lots of Quality of Life improvements, such as killfeeds, fishing widgets and cosmetic previews 

### Resource packs
- MCC Island Lobby panorama (enabled by default)
- All 10 faction base panoramas

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.19.2+

Install the .mrpack with your preferred launcher (Modrinth App, Prism), connect to mccisland.net, and you're ready to play!
